constraints.constraint: Keep module to ~50 lines as specified in tech spec (Section 3.1)
New code must have 80%+ test coverage - CI/CD will block merge if not met
Overall project coverage must not decrease (ratchet enforcement)
Use simple, direct SDK calls - no custom wrappers or abstractions
Tests must use APP_ENV=test (auto-configured in conftest.py)
Extraction accuracy must be 90%+ on sample documents
Processing time must be less than 2 minutes for 5 documents

interface.name: extract_timeseries
interface.signature: async def extract_timeseries(docs: List[str], metric: str = "revenue") -> TimeSeriesData
interface.purpose: Main entry point for time-series extraction from documents

interface.name: normalize_to_interval
interface.signature: def normalize_to_interval(data: TimeSeriesData, interval: str) -> TimeSeriesData
interface.purpose: Normalize extracted data to consistent time intervals

interface.name: TimeSeriesPoint
interface.signature: class TimeSeriesPoint(BaseModel): date: datetime, value: float, label: str | None
interface.purpose: Single data point in a time series

interface.name: TimeSeriesData
interface.signature: class TimeSeriesData(BaseModel): metric_name: str, points: List[TimeSeriesPoint], interval: str, source_documents: List[str]
interface.purpose: Collection of time series data for a financial metric

interface.name: search_documents
interface.signature: async def search_documents(query: str, top_k: int = 5, filters: dict | None = None) -> list[QueryResult]
interface.purpose: Reuse for finding time-series chunks in documents

tests.standards: pytest framework with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Unit tests mock external dependencies (LLM, Qdrant). Integration tests use test database (APP_ENV=test, Qdrant:6335, PostgreSQL:5433). Coverage enforced at 80%+ for new code via CI/CD gates. Follow existing test patterns in tests/unit/ and tests/integration/.
